title: SceneProperties — incremental contract for spec #258
description: JSON Schema fragment showing the additive change to SceneProperties contributed by feature #258. The final generated schema (emitted from storyboard.yaml by gen-json-schema) will subsume this; this file is the authoritative human-readable contract for the slot added by this feature.

display_mode.title: Time-controller display mode at capture time
display_mode.description: Captured value of the session-state Zustand store's displayMode at the moment the scene was created. On scene activation, the host wires StoryboardPanel.onSceneActivated to session.setDisplayMode(display_mode). The slot is OPTIONAL to permit legacy scenes (pre-#258) to load without modification; the host leaves the time-controller untouched when the slot is absent.

_polygon_source.title: Provenance of the scene's stored polygon geometry
_polygon_source.description: Records how scene.geometry was produced. 'bounds' = computed from the real Leaflet map bounds at capture time (post-#258 norm). 'placeholder' = pre-#258 ~100m square. 'manual' = reserved for future user-drawn rectangles. Render-side consumers (SceneRectangleLayer) recompute the polygon from (viewport, map.getSize()) when this value is anything other than 'bounds' or is absent. The stored geometry is NEVER rewritten on read (Article III.2 source preservation).

display_mode.writer_invariant: display_mode === session.getState().displayMode at the moment of createScene
display_mode.reader_invariant_present: host wires StoryboardPanel.onSceneActivated to call session.setDisplayMode(display_mode)
display_mode.reader_invariant_absent: host MUST NOT change the current displayMode and MUST NOT raise

_polygon_source.writer_invariant: createScene/updateScene populating geometry via bboxToPolygon(map.getBounds(), 'bounds') MUST set _polygon_source = 'bounds'
_polygon_source.reader_invariant: SceneRectangleLayer recomputes polygon from (viewport, map.getSize()) when value !== 'bounds' or slot is absent; MUST NOT rewrite the stored geometry
